title: Minecraft Server
subtitle: Manage the Bedrock server for PS5 and Android

menu.label: Minecraft
menu.description: Start, stop and monitor the Bedrock server

error.spawn_failed: Could not start the server process.
error.no_free_port: No free port found (all checked UDP ports are in use).
error.conflict: Name or port was just taken, please try again.
error.folder_delete_failed: The folder could not be deleted. The server is removed, delete the folder manually.

form.name: Name
form.editText: Change name, game mode and player limit. Ports and folder stay.
form.restartHint: Changes apply after the server restarts.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.text: The server is removed and can no longer be started.
delete.worldKept: The world stays on disk under {{folder}} and is not deleted.
delete.filesWarning: The folder {{folder}} including the world will be deleted permanently.

terminal.title: Terminal: {{name}}
terminal.description: Server console with history and command input

error.invalid_command: Invalid command (empty, too long or multi-line).

commands.kick: Kick a player from the server
commands.allowlistAdd: Add a gamertag to the allowlist
commands.allowlistRemove: Remove a gamertag from the allowlist
commands.gamerule: Read or set a game rule

kick.title: Kick “{{name}}”?
kick.text: The player is removed from the server and can rejoin right away.

broadcast.title: Message to everyone: {{name}}
broadcast.text: Shown to all players on the server.

error.busy: A backup is already running for this server.
error.hold_failed: The server did not report a safe state. No backup was created.
error.restore_failed: Restore failed. The world is unchanged if the backup could not be extracted.

backup.title: Backups: {{name}}
backup.description: Create, restore and delete world backups
backup.stopFirst: The server must be stopped to restore.
backup.restoreText: The current world is replaced by {{file}}. The previous world stays in the server folder as worlds.before-restore (one level only).
backup.emptyText: Back up this server's world so you can restore it later.

linkError.unknown: The download link could not be created.
linkError.busy: Too many open download links. Please wait a moment.

pass.title: Player pass
pass.description: Gamertags allowed to join all servers
pass.emptyText: Users add gamertags in the account area.
pass.deleteText: {{name}} is removed from all servers and kicked if online.

schedule.title: Backup schedule
schedule.hourHint: 0–23, server time. The backup starts shortly after the full hour (at :07).
schedule.keepHint: 1–30 per server, older ones are deleted.
schedule.summary: Daily at {{time}} (server time), the latest {{keep}} per server are kept.
